finding: First_Gen holds Y/N (the dictionary codes parents' education) and disagrees with NASPAFirstGeneration where both are known
proposed_fix: Don't read First_Gen as a dictionary code; flag rows where the two columns contradict. Ask Achieving the Dream what Y/N means.

finding: Year 3/4 credits attempted are 0 instead of blank for years after 2025-26 (count is Yr3 + Yr4 attempted)
proposed_fix: Blank them; the loader's future_credit_years_are_blank rule does this. The 2025-26 cutoff is an assumption (9 course rows are dated 2026-27).

finding: Retention = 1 students with a course row at another college in year 1 or 2 still have Persistence = 0
proposed_fix: Don't overwrite Persistence; derive an enrolled-elsewhere flag from the course file. Question for PDP.

finding: Year-1 credits attempted differ from the sum of the student's year-1 course credits (GPA differs for about half of students)
proposed_fix: Keep reported values; add the recomputed credits beside them and flag mismatches. Ask PDP how year 1 is defined.

finding: The same prefix + number maps to more than one Course_Name (Institution ID is absent; the files can't show whether these names come from different institutions)
proposed_fix: Identify a class by prefix + number + name; the real fix is the Institution ID column.

finding: Ethnicity = UK while Race is a specific race (the course file repeats it)
proposed_fix: Keep UK (the dictionary doesn't make a specific Race imply N); flag it and ask Achieving the Dream. Don't count these as non-Hispanic.

finding: Pell_Status_First_Year = U (not a dictionary code)
proposed_fix: Read U as unknown (UK).

finding: Math_or_English_Gateway = NA on class rows where the dictionary has N (N never appears)
proposed_fix: Map NA to N; the loader's gateway_na_is_n rule does this.

finding: Credential_Type_Sought_Year_1 holds labels instead of codes and spells the teacher-certification label two ways (count is the 'Teach' spelling)
proposed_fix: Map labels to codes; the loader's credential_labels_are_codes rule does this. Degree Seeking(N)/(Y) have no code.

finding: Time_to_Credential is longer than the years since the cohort started (max 27.7)
proposed_fix: Flag; Dual_and_Summer_Enrollment = UK doesn't rule out an earlier start.

finding: Duplicate class rows: same student / class / section / year / term / name (count is extra rows); most differ only in Cohort_Term or Course_CIP
proposed_fix: Take Cohort_Term from the cohort file; drop exact copies; of CIP-only copies keep the one with a CIP. Copies that differ in grade or credits need a decision.

finding: Other college's state / type / locale blank although the year column says a degree or enrollment happened there (S_/C_/L_ are always blank together)
proposed_fix: Mark as UK so blank keeps meaning not applicable; don't guess.

finding: Course-file Cohort_Term disagrees with the cohort file (mostly copies Academic_Term)
impact: breaks analysis if the course value is used
proposed_fix: Use the cohort file's Cohort_Term; the loader keeps the course value separately (course_file_cohort_term).

finding: Course rows with no term and no class; each is the student's only row
proposed_fix: Drop the empty rows; keep the students' cohort rows.

finding: Race cut at 25 characters (cohort rows; 1798 course rows too)
proposed_fix: Restore the two labels; the loader's race_cut_at_25_characters rule does this.

finding: Course_CIP lost its leading zero (5.0202; 9.01; 1)
proposed_fix: Zero-pad the CIP family; the loader's cip_lost_its_zeros (1239 rows); cip_series_lost_its_zeros (330) and cip_family_lost_its_zero (69) rules do this.

finding: Program codes stored as 5 digits (leading zero lost; count is Program_of_Study_Term_1)
proposed_fix: Zero-pad to 6 digits; the loader's three program-of-study number_format rules do this.

finding: Section_ID in scientific notation (digits lost)
proposed_fix: Not recoverable; flag.

finding: C_Enrollment_Record_at_other cut at 50 characters
proposed_fix: Not recoverable; flag.

finding: Class rows before the cohort year; most of their students have Dual_and_Summer_Enrollment = UK
proposed_fix: Flag rows as pre-cohort so first-year metrics can exclude them.

finding: Student_GUIDs that appear in two cohorts (count is extra cohort rows; their 63 course rows double on a GUID-only join)
proposed_fix: Join on Student_GUID + Cohort; the loader keeps both and lets the later cohort win for student columns.

finding: Joining course to cohort on Student_GUID alone adds course rows (count is the extra rows)
proposed_fix: Always join on Student_GUID + Cohort.

finding: Duplicate Student_GUID + Cohort keys in the cohort file (expected 0)
proposed_fix: None needed; keep checking.

finding: Orphans on Student_GUID + Cohort: course rows with no cohort row plus cohort rows with no course row (expected 0)
proposed_fix: None needed; keep checking.

finding: Time_to_Credential is '.' although the student earned a credential at the cohort institution
proposed_fix: Flag; filling from the year would invent a decimal.

finding: Years_ values that point past 2025-26
proposed_fix: Blank and flag.

finding: Grade F with credits earned
proposed_fix: Flag; don't change either column.

finding: Course_End_Date in 2029
proposed_fix: Blank and flag.

finding: Core_Course_Type holds single letters with no key (the dictionary expects text)
proposed_fix: Keep as an opaque code; ask Achieving the Dream for the key.

finding: Full-Time students with fewer than 12 first-term course credits (almost all Summer starters)
proposed_fix: Flag; the institution's threshold isn't in the files.

finding: Gateway attempt unknown (UK) but completion coded D (math + English)
proposed_fix: Keep D (the dictionary defines it independently); flag so rates can be shown with and without these. Ask PDP.

finding: Contradictory or suspect gateway flags: completed with an attempt of N (or UK: suspect); completed with a failing grade; required with a blank attempt (math + English)
proposed_fix: Flag per subject.

finding: Gateway attempted = Y but no gateway class row in the cohort's first academic year (math + English; 263 with a 4-terms-from-entry window)
proposed_fix: Flag; either the flag or the course rows are incomplete.

finding: Gateway flag on developmental (CC/CD) classes
proposed_fix: Flag so gateway counts can exclude them.

finding: Developmental completion uses Y/N instead of C/D; count is students who didn't attempt but have a completion value (math + English)
proposed_fix: Y/N -> C/D (the loader's dev_*_completion_is_c_d rules; assumes Y = completed; confirm with Achieving the Dream). Not attempted + D can be consistent; flag only real contradictions.

finding: Values the dictionary doesn't list. Count is Attendance_Status_Term_1; also Student_Age Unknown; Enrollment_Type Continuing; Intensity Unknown; GPA UK; grades OTH/UW/N/MIS/CHE/UK; instructor rank -1; Section_ID NA/UK
proposed_fix: Unknown-style markers -> missing per column; keep meaningful codes as written and ask Achieving the Dream.

finding: Mixed null markers (blank / . / NA / UK / Unknown / MISSING / -1); count is Course_CIP = MISSING
proposed_fix: Normalize per column (see --missing); never with one global na_values list.

finding: Real Course_Prefix 'NA' (Nursing Assistant) becomes NaN under pandas defaults
proposed_fix: Read with keep_default_na=False.

finding: Nonresident alien with Ethnicity = H (also 4 cohort / 79 course rows with blank Ethnicity)
proposed_fix: Keep (may be true); read blank Ethnicity as UK.

finding: Enrolled elsewhere = Y but S_/C_/L_ blank
proposed_fix: Mark as UK.

finding: Cut C_ value no longer lines up with S_ (different number of entries)
proposed_fix: Flag; not recoverable.

finding: Course_CIP is a two-digit integer such as 44: a real CIP series or a code that lost its decimals (1 is counted in 13b)
proposed_fix: Keep as written and flag; it can't be told apart from a real series.

finding: Passing grade with credits attempted but 0 earned (mostly P)
proposed_fix: Flag; don't change either column.

finding: Course begin month outside the term's assumed months (Fall Jul-Nov / Spring Dec-Apr / Summer Apr-Aug / Winter Nov-Feb)
proposed_fix: Flag.

finding: Retention = 0 but the student has class rows in the cohort's second academic year
proposed_fix: Don't overwrite Retention; flag.

finding: Time_to_Credential more than a year past the first-credential year
proposed_fix: Flag.

finding: Students with no class rows but year-1 credits attempted
proposed_fix: Flag so course-based metrics exclude them instead of counting 0 classes.

finding: First class in an earlier term of the cohort year than Cohort_Term
proposed_fix: Flag; can't tell which term is wrong.

finding: Year-1 GPA = 0 although credits were earned
proposed_fix: Flag; a GPA of 0 with pass-only or failed credits can be real.

finding: Year-1 credits attempted below the dictionary minimum of 1
proposed_fix: Set to missing and flag.

finding: Co_requisite_Course blank on half the class rows (dictionary allows only Y/N)
proposed_fix: Read blank as unknown (UK); not as N.

finding: Course_CIP lost trailing zeros (13.121 is 13.1210; 45.1 is 45.10)
proposed_fix: Pad with zeros; the loader's cip_lost_its_trailing_zero (702 rows) and cip_series_lost_its_zeros (2) rules do this.
